# bcm_cmdevice_nodes (Data Source)

Fetches cluster nodes from BCM CMDevice service with comprehensive metadata including network interfaces and roles.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Query all cluster nodes
data "bcm_cmdevice_nodes" "all" {}

# Output all node information
output "all_nodes" {
  value = data.bcm_cmdevice_nodes.all.nodes
}

# Output node count
output "node_count" {
  value = length(data.bcm_cmdevice_nodes.all.nodes)
}

# Output just hostnames
output "hostnames" {
  value = [for node in data.bcm_cmdevice_nodes.all.nodes : node.hostname]
}

# Create inventory map
output "node_inventory" {
  value = {
    for node in data.bcm_cmdevice_nodes.all.nodes :
    node.hostname => {
      uuid       = node.uuid
      type       = node.child_type
      mac        = node.mac
      interfaces = length(node.interfaces)
      roles = [
        for role in node.roles :
        role.name if role.name != null
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (Block, Optional) Optional filter criteria to limit returned nodes. Multiple filters are AND-ed together. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--filter))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier for the data source.
- `nodes` (Attributes List) List of cluster nodes matching the filter criteria. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--nodes))

<a id="nestedblock--filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter`

Optional:

- `category_uuid` (String) Filter by category UUID (exact match).
- `child_type` (String) Filter by node childType (exact match, case-sensitive). Example: 'PhysicalNode'.
- `hostname_pattern` (String) Filter by hostname substring (case-insensitive). Example: 'compute' matches 'compute-node-01'.


<a id="nestedatt--nodes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `nodes`

Read-Only:

- `authentication_service` (String) Authentication service type.
- `base_type` (String) Entity base type (always 'Device').
- `category` (String) Category UUID.
- `child_type` (String) Specific node type (PhysicalNode, HeadNode, ComputeNode, CloudNode, StorageNode).
- `creation_time` (Number) Node creation time (Unix timestamp in seconds).
- `hostname` (String) Node hostname.
- `id` (String) Node UUID (same as uuid).
- `interfaces` (Attributes List) Network interfaces configured on the node. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--nodes--interfaces))
- `mac` (String) Primary MAC address.
- `modified` (Boolean) Indicates if node has unsaved changes.
- `partition` (String) Partition UUID.
- `power_control` (String) Power control method (none, ipmi, redfish, pdu).
- `provisioning_transport` (String) Provisioning transport method.
- `roles` (Attributes List) Service roles assigned to the node. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--nodes--roles))
- `to_be_removed` (Boolean) Indicates if node is scheduled for deletion.
- `uuid` (String) Unique node identifier (RFC 4122 UUID format).

<a id="nestedatt--nodes--interfaces"></a>
### Nested Schema for `nodes.interfaces`

Read-Only:

- `base_type` (String) Entity base type (always 'NetworkInterface').
- `bootable` (Boolean) PXE boot capable flag.
- `cardtype` (String) Network card type (Ethernet, InfiniBand, etc.).
- `child_type` (String) Interface type (NetworkPhysicalInterface, NetworkBondInterface, etc.).
- `dhcp` (Boolean) DHCP enabled flag.
- `ip` (String) IPv4 address.
- `ipv6_ip` (String) IPv6 address.
- `mac` (String) Interface MAC address.
- `name` (String) Interface name (e.g., ens33).
- `network` (String) Network UUID reference.
- `start_if` (String) Startup condition (ALWAYS, NEVER, HOTPLUG).


<a id="nestedatt--nodes--roles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `nodes.roles`

Read-Only:

- `add_services` (Boolean) Auto-add related services flag.
- `base_type` (String) Entity base type (always 'Role').
- `child_type` (String) Role type (HeadNodeRole, ComputeRole, etc.).
- `name` (String) Role name.
- `uuid` (String) Role UUID.
